q: Lott-Sturm-Villani theory defines Ricci curvature bounds for metric measure spaces via optimal transport. A space (X,d,m) satisfies CD(K,∞) (curvature ≥ K) if:
opts: The entropy functional H_m(ρ) = ∫ρ log ρ dm is K-convex along W₂-geodesics
The Wasserstein distance satisfies W₂ ≥ K
exp: CD(K,∞): H_m(ρ) = ∫ρlog ρ dm is K-convex along W₂-geodesics (displacement convexity). This generalises Ricci curvature ≥ K for Riemannian manifolds to metric measure spaces (by the Otto-Villani equivalence: K-convexity of entropy ↔ Ric ≥ K for smooth manifolds).
